symbols.read: The bullish call has triggered and delivered: price broke the 345.34 pivot that capped the prior read and has run to 362.27, now sitting above the new upper pivot at 348.15 with the 1H trend still up. The prior 333.68–333.86 bull FVG is gone — no open FVGs remain — so the nearest support reference is now the pivot/stop zone at 346.37–348.15, with entry 348.15, stop 346.37, target 370.49. Bias stays bullish, but the regime has cooled from BULLISH to NEUTRAL and price is extended well above entry, so chasing here is poor risk; the actionable setup is a hold above 348.15 or a pullback into it. Invalidation is a break below 346.37, which would undercut the pivot and the 1H uptrend.

The bias has flipped from constructive to bearish: the 1D direction turned bearish and the combined signal dropped to HOLD, with price at 261.35 now sitting inside a fresh bearish FVG (258.41–263.49) that caps upside where none existed before. The prior long setup is dead — price broke below the 260.14 entry and sits just above the 258.55 stop, so that invalidation has effectively triggered. The new short is a watching setup, not active: entry 244.72, stop 246.66, target 224.11, with the lower pivot at 244.72 and upper pivot 265.34. Bias stays bearish below 265.34, and a push back above that pivot (filling the FVG) invalidates the short and neutralizes the read.

AVGO has broken down decisively: price at 324.80 has lost both the 380.84 upper pivot and the 328.58 lower pivot, and the 1H trend has flipped from up to down, confirming the daily bearish bias rather than conflicting with it. The bias is now a watching sell, with entry at 328.58, stop at 332.07, and target at 276.32, supported by three stacked bearish FVGs (330.82–338.03, 327.16–335.15, 325.89–326.18) that now act as overhead supply. This revises the prior watching-buy read outright — the 377.74 invalidation was blown through and the 380.84 hold condition failed, so the setup is no longer armed long. Reclaiming 332.07 invalidates the short; a push back above the 335.15 FVG top would neutralize the bearish structure.

BRK.B has broken decisively above the 523.74 trigger, with price now at 570.47 — a ~11% advance that confirms the prior bullish bias and shifts the read from watching to a live BUY. The 1D bullish regime holds and the 1H trend remains up, but the combined signal is still HOLD and the regime is now NEUTRAL, so momentum is lagging the breakout rather than confirming it. All three prior bullish FVGs have been consumed (no open FVGs remain), removing the support shelf that previously underpinned the structure; the new reference is the 543.34 upper pivot, which now serves as entry with stop 541.59 and target 590.72. Invalidation moves up to a push back below 495.96, and the bias stays bullish only while price holds above 543.34.

Bias flips from HOLD to SELL: price has broken well below the prior 339.89 trigger and now sits at 323.12, with the 1H trend turned down and the combined 1D+1H read confirming SELL — a clear change from the prior neutral stall at 347.89. The overhead bearish FVG at 349.69–350.28 is now far out of reach, and three fresh bearish FVGs (331.43–333.83, 326.49–327.01, 323.68–326.13) cap any bounce, with the entry at 330.38, stop 332.81, and target 301.36. The setup invalidates on a reclaim above 332.81, and the prior 364.17 repair level is now irrelevant to the immediate structure.

LLY remains a BUY but is now WATCHING just below the 1,311.75 upper pivot at 1,311.08, with the 1D direction and 1D+1H combined read still bullish and the 1H trend up. The prior read's 1,316.71 target has effectively been reached and reset higher to 1,492.29, while the old 1,215.00 entry and 1,204.71 stop are obsolete — the setup has migrated up to entry 1,311.75 and stop 1,300.38. The two bearish FVGs below 1,200 are now far out of play, replaced by three bullish FVGs at 1,272.33–1,272.36, 1,273.36–1,275.10, and 1,275.18–1,301.46 acting as support beneath price. Bias is bullish above 1,311.75; invalidation is a decisive break back below 1,311.75, which reverts to a hold and exposes the 1,131.21 lower pivot. Note the regime has flipped to NEUTRAL, so confirmation of the pivot reclaim is needed before the entry triggers.

META's bias has flipped from BUY to SELL: price collapsed from 761.46 to 684.36, breaking the 738.71–741.57 downside FVG and the 771.24 invalidation that anchored the prior long thesis, with the 1D direction now bearish and the 1H trend down. Price is pressing the 681.05 lower pivot, which doubles as the entry trigger, with a fresh bearish FVG overhead at 681.07–706.69 and the 779.82 upper pivot now far out of reach. The last 1H bar was flat (643.00→642.75, -0.04%), so the move is stalled at support rather than accelerating, and the regime reads NEUTRAL rather than confirming trend conviction. Entry is 681.05 with stop 687.81 and target 582.28; invalidation is a reclaim above 687.81, which would put price back inside the bearish FVG and undercut the short setup.

MSFT has broken decisively above the 523.89–528.89 bearish FVG that capped the prior read, with price now at 550.02 pressing the 551.15 upper pivot — a clear bullish resolution versus the prior neutral-to-cautious stance. The 1H trend has flipped up (from down) and the 1D stays bullish, though the combined signal remains HOLD, so the bias is now cautiously bullish pending a pivot reclaim. The setup: entry 551.15, stop 547.83, target 611.08, with the 537.5–539.04 bearish FVG below as the nearest support shelf. Invalidation is a break below 547.83, which would reopen the 491.22 lower pivot; a decisive close above 551.15 confirms the long toward 611.08.

Bias has flipped bearish on the daily and the intraday call has moved from invalidated-buy to a watching sell: price collapsed from 230.49 to 212.68, breaking well below the prior 208.93 downside focus's neighborhood and now sitting directly on the lower pivot at 212.77. The 1H downtrend persists and the last candle (212.46→212.68) is a weak stall at the pivot, not a reclaim, with fresh bearish FVGs at 214.17–215.09, 215.20–220.26, and 218.88–221.32 stacked overhead to cap any bounce. The sell setup triggers at 212.77 with stop 214.54 and target 182.17; invalidation is a close back above 214.54, which would also put price into the lowest FVG and threaten the setup. The 243.37 reclaim level that previously defined the bullish revival is now far out of reach and no longer the operative line — the 212.77 pivot is.

TSLA's bullish bias is intact but the setup has weakened: price at 377.86 has slipped below the 388.84 upper pivot that now defines the entry, so the trade is watching rather than active, with the 1H trend still up and the combined 1D+1H signal still BUY. Versus the previous read, the 386.83 support that was holding has been lost and the pivot has shifted up to 388.84, meaning price must reclaim that level to trigger entry; the empty FVG field still offers no overhead drag. The operative stop is 385.12 under the 388.84 entry, with 431.81 as the target, and the lower pivot at 345.88 remains the invalidation for the broader structure. Bias stays bullish, but confirmation now requires a close back above 388.84.
